validation: all 632 development questions before training and after every epoch
checkpoint_selection: highest development accuracy with exact binary aliases; tie lower development CE; earliest epoch on equal values
trainable: active CLIP and DINO projectors only; CLIP initialization shared across arms within model
precision: FP32 projector parameters and optimizer states, BF16 autocast
rationale: Fixed modest three-epoch exploratory adaptation budget for 2475 supervised questions; evaluate every epoch and select only on development. No efficacy or convergence presumed.
limitations: Fusion has more trainable parameters; report parameter counts and cost
One initialization in initial campaign; no claim of seed-robust superiority
training_gate: all four real loss-gradient-update-reload checks plus optimizer/RNG/cursor resume check must pass before production training
